description: PR #2140 fork (SP8192_CaseOps_Progressive3k_ShortDocTTT) ported to ROCm + 3 levers (asym_logit_rescale, gptq_cal=32, gptq_reserve=2.0) + cap-fit env (embed_bits=7, mlp_clip_sigmas=11.5). Recipe validated on 1×A100 SECURE; awaiting 8×H100 SXM production run.
notes: Cap-fit corrected vs LUMI 1.05320 (17.20 MB over-cap). The two cap-fit env vars (EMBED_BITS=7, MLP_CLIP_SIGMAS=11.5) diverge from script defaults (8, 10.0) and save 487+574=1061 KB. Validated 2026-05-13 on 1×A100 SECURE with QUANTIZE_ONLY=1: LUMI fp32 + corrected env block → 15,981,515 bytes (under cap by 18,485 bytes). Pre-TTT BPB 1.06739. Projected post-TTT ~1.0554. Status: pending 8×H100 SXM run (RunPod GPU availability constrained as of 2026-05-13 ~00:30). When an 8×H100 pod becomes available, the run's stdout should match the anchor lines in expected_log.txt (val_bpb, 'Total submission size', embed_bits, mlp_clip_sigmas, stopping_early step); the val_bpb/val_bpb_postquant/artifact_bytes fields here will then be replaced with the measured values.

lineage.lumi_historical_caveat: Over 16MB cap due to EMBED_BITS=8 (script default) instead of PR #2140 intended 7, and MLP_CLIP_SIGMAS=10.0 instead of intended 11.5.
